core: IKK-NF-κB activation by innate and TNF-family receptors
qualifier: canonical and non-canonical, incl. TNFR/CD40 and IRF3/7 branches
name: TLR/TNFR-driven canonical and non-canonical NF-κB activation
rationale: All members concern IKK/TAK1/TRAF6/RIP1-mediated NF-κB (and adjacent IRF3/7, necroptosis) signalling downstream of TLR, TNFR1 and TNF-family receptors; unlike confusables with NOD/JNK/p38 or TLR3/4-only content, this theme covers non-canonical NIK signalling, TNFR/CD40 and NF-κB pathway deficiencies.

qualifier: DNA unwinding, break-induced replication and recombination-intermediate resolution
name: Telomeric recombination, break-induced replication and intermediate resolution
rationale: Members share helicase-dependent telomere replication/recombination (D-loop, t-circles, capping) and replication-coupled DSB repair; distinct from confusables by DNA unwinding, break-induced replication, mitotic recombination-intermediate resolution and the intra-S checkpoint.

qualifier: with cardiomyocyte proliferation and differentiation control
name: Heart wall morphogenesis and cardiomyocyte proliferation/differentiation control
rationale: Members cover myocardial (trabecular, compact, atrial, ventricular), endocardial and coronary vascular morphogenesis; the positive/negative regulation of cardiomyocyte proliferation and differentiation separates it from C1, and endocardium/coronary content from the regeneration/hypertrophy and early heart-tube confusables.

core: Endocytic recycling to the plasma membrane
qualifier: constitutive secretory delivery
name: Endocytic recycling and constitutive plasma membrane delivery
rationale: Members concern traffic between plasma membrane, endosomes and the constitutive secretory route (receptor/endocytic recycling, endosome organization); confusables instead emphasize Golgi-endosome-lysosome retrograde transport and Rab/ARF signalling.

qualifier: suppression of recombination, NHEJ and telomerase
name: Telomere capping suppressing recombination, NHEJ and telomerase
rationale: All members concern protective packaging of telomere ends that blocks recombination, NHEJ and telomerase access; confusables instead centre on C-strand replication, D-loop/t-circle processing or telomerase recruitment.

qualifier: satellite cell-driven muscle regeneration
name: Myoblast proliferation and differentiation in satellite cell-driven muscle regeneration
rationale: Members regulate skeletal myoblast/myotube proliferation, differentiation and fusion; satellite cell activation/maintenance, stem cell division and regeneration distinguish it from myogenesis-commitment confusables.

qualifier: with BCR proximal signalling and its tuning
name: B cell activation and development with BCR signal tuning
rationale: Members concern B cell development, proliferation, homeostasis and B-cell-enriched expression with BCR second-messenger, RAS, BTK and CD22 signalling plus inhibitory modulation; confusables lack the BCR proximal signalling and instead carry B/plasma cell surface signatures or T cell content.

qualifier: APC/C-regulated mitotic exit
name: Mitotic division and APC/C-regulated mitotic exit
rationale: Members span mitotic condensation, cohesion, spindle, centrosome, nuclear envelope and cytokinesis; the APC/C substrate degradation, Emi1/Cdh1/Cdc20 control and mitotic exit members separate it from confusables that add meiosis or cohesin loading.

qualifier: with splicing and nuclear export control
name: mRNA stabilization with splicing and nuclear export control
rationale: Members stabilize mRNAs (CRD, IGF2BP, 3'-UTR, decay inhibition) and regulate splicing, export and translation; confusables instead centre on mRNA decay/deadenylation, 3'-end processing or miRNA silencing.

qualifier: phosphatidylglycerol and cardiolipin synthesis and remodelling
name: Glycerophospholipid synthesis with phosphatidylglycerol and cardiolipin remodelling
rationale: Members synthesize PC, PE, PS, PG and CL from CDP-DAG/CDP-choline; PG/CL acyl-chain remodelling and lipid transfer distinguish it from confusables focused on scrambling, catabolism or PC/PE/PI/PS remodelling.

qualifier: de novo synthesis and lysosomal catabolism
name: Sphingolipid and glycosphingolipid synthesis and lysosomal catabolism
rationale: Members cover ceramide/sphingomyelin/ganglioside synthesis, transport and lysosomal degradation (incl. GM2 gangliosidoses, sialidosis); de novo sphingolipid synthesis separates it from GPI-anchor confusables and lysosomal glycosphingolipid content from C3.

qualifier: receptor/ligand proteolytic processing
name: Notch and Hedgehog signalling via proteolytic processing
rationale: Members concern Notch receptor processing and NICD transcription plus Hedgehog autoprocessing, release, SMO and GLI processing, with regulated intramembrane proteolysis; confusables lack Notch or Hedgehog and add Wnt, ERBB4 or protein palmitoylation.

qualifier: fear, ethanol and drinking behaviour
name: Stress-axis behavioural responses: fear, ethanol and drinking
rationale: Members concern behavioural responses to stress hormones and stressors (corticosterone, CRH, immobilization, fear) and ethanol/drinking behaviour; confusables cover other behaviours or HPA hormone secretion.

qualifier: restraining granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation
name: Myeloid progenitor transcription restraining granulocyte and macrophage differentiation
rationale: Members concern transcriptional control of HSC/myeloid progenitors (RUNX1, VENTX, promyelocyte module, GM-CSF) and negative regulation of terminal myeloid differentiation; confusables carry positive regulation and mature granulocyte/monocyte programmes.

qualifier: via soluble-agonist receptors (thrombin, ADP, thromboxane, prostacyclin)
name: Platelet activation and aggregation via soluble-agonist receptors
rationale: All members concern platelet activation, aggregation, degranulation and coagulation; the thrombin PAR, P2Y1/P2Y12, TP and prostacyclin receptor signalling distinguishes it from adhesion (GPIb, collagen) and integrin/Rap1 confusables.

qualifier: threonine and histidine
name: Amino acid catabolism, notably threonine and histidine
rationale: Members are amino/organic acid metabolic terms anchored by threonine and histidine catabolism; confusables centre on tyrosine, phenylalanine, proline, glycine or sulfur amino acids.

qualifier: with contractile force and heart rate regulation
name: Cardiomyocyte growth, hypertrophy and contractility regulation
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth, hypertrophy, regeneration and survival plus contraction force and heart rate; contractility members separate it from C3, and cardiac (not smooth) muscle from the other confusables.

qualifier: NOTCH2-4 and developmental contexts
name: Notch target-gene transcription by NOTCH2-4 in differentiation
rationale: Members concern Notch intracellular domain-driven HLH target transcription (NOTCH2/3/4, RUNX3, Th2, pancreatic bud); confusables centre on NOTCH1 activation and oncogenic NOTCH1 mutants.

core: Cytochrome P450 and lipoxygenase eicosanoid synthesis
qualifier: 12-lipoxygenase/hepoxilin branch and inherited defects
name: Cytochrome P450 and 12-lipoxygenase eicosanoid synthesis and defects
rationale: Members oxygenate arachidonic/linoleic acid via P450 epoxygenase, omega-hydroxylase and 12-lipoxygenase routes and include CYP/transport disease variants; these defects and the hepoxilin branch separate it from catabolism-oriented confusables, and the P450 routes from C4.

qualifier: vocal learning, sensorimotor gating and forebrain development
name: Social, vocal and sensory-processing behaviour and forebrain development
rationale: Members concern social interaction, vocalization, observational learning, prepulse inhibition, touch/auditory/visual behaviour and amygdala/striatum development; confusables centre on locomotor, motor and other exploratory behaviours.

qualifier: endocardial cushion EMT
name: Endocardial cushion EMT-driven valve and septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover endocardial cushion EMT and fusion and formation of all four valves and atrial/ventricular septa; confusables center on trabeculation, AV canal, aorta or septal apoptosis.

core: T and B cell antigen-receptor signalling
qualifier: with CD28 co-stimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition
name: T and B cell antigen-receptor signalling with CD28/CTLA4 co-signals
rationale: Members concern proximal TCR (CD3/ZAP-70) and BCR (BTK, RAS) signalling plus CD28 co-stimulation and CTLA4/BTLA inhibition; confusables lack either the B cell or the T cell co-signalling arm.

qualifier: with mitochondrial calcium uptake regulation
name: Mitochondrial protein import, processing and calcium uniporter regulation
rationale: Members concern targeting, import, presequence processing and degradation of mitochondrial proteins plus SMDT1/MCU-related calcium import; confusables instead include cristae formation and mitochondrial fusion.

qualifier: myocardium, endocardium and coronary vasculature
name: Myocardial, endocardial and coronary vascular heart wall morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover trabecular/compact/atrial/ventricular myocardium, endocardium, coronary vasculogenesis and muscular septum formation; endocardial/coronary content separates it from ventricle-formation and septum confusables, and myocardial wall content from valve/aorta ones.

qualifier: PERK/IRE1 arms and stress translational control
name: ER unfolded protein response: PERK/IRE1 arms and translation control
rationale: Members concern UPR signalling via PERK and IRE1, stress-regulated translation initiation and ER stress apoptosis; confusables are ATF6-only, HRI/GCN2 integrated stress or mitochondrial UPR.
